title: Fixed participants can claim more premium than expected
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High, wrong premium amount will allow some participants to withdraw more than others  **Likelihood:** High, always occur as fixed participants will claim premiums  ## Description  `claimFixedPremium()` is called to allow fixed participants to claim their fixed premium when vault is started. And `sendAmount`, the premium amount to be claimed, is determined by the participant's share of `variableSideCapacity`, using their balance of `fixedClaimTokens` over `fixedLidoSharesTotalSupply()`.
